name: invoice_data_report
goal: Here are three months of invoice exports from our billing system (the data/ folder, June to August 2026). Give me reports/top_customers.csv with our 10 biggest customers by total billed in EUR, and reports/duplicate_invoices.csv listing invoices that were billed twice (or more). The exports aren't perfectly clean. README.md describes the columns, the currency-rate file and exactly what the two reports should look like.
